Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units from activities for assay CHEMBL4689846. Join assays filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4689846'. Join molecule_dictionary on molregno for chembl_id. Inner join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to exact activity measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
